name: cascode_mirror_4x
description: 4:1 NMOS cascode current mirror (wide-swing, self-biased). Iout = 4 x Iref. M1/M3 diode-connected input branch generates gate biases; M2/M4 output branch sized 4x via 4 unit fingers for exact 1:4 ratio. Cascode (M4) shields M2 drain keeping Vds2 = Vgs1, giving high output resistance and current accuracy independent of output voltage.

M2.role: output mirror (4x unit cells for 1:4 ratio)

M4.role: output cascode (4x unit cells, matches M2)

nets.VDD: Positive supply rail (3.3V) - bulk/body tie reference
nets.VSS: Ground / negative supply - common source and bulk of all NMOS
nets.iref: Reference current input node (top of input branch, drain of M3)
nets.iout: Scaled output current node (top of output branch, drain of M4)
nets.n1: Input branch mid-net: drain of M1 = source of M3 = gate of M1 = gate of M2 (bottom bias / diode net)
nets.n2: Output branch mid-net: drain of M2 = source of M4 (cascode-shielded drain of M2)
nets.pbias: Cascode gate bias net: gate of M3 = gate of M4 = drain of M3 (diode-generated cascode bias)

components.name: M1
components.note: Diode-connected input mirror device. d=g=n1 establishes Vgs bias for the mirror pair.

components.name: M3
components.note: Diode-connected input cascode. d=iref, g=pbias (self-biased). Source sits on n1 (M1 drain).

components.name: M2
components.note: Output mirror device, 4 fingers (4x unit width). g=n1 shares M1's diode bias -> Iout = 4*Iref.

components.name: M4
components.note: Output cascode device, 4 fingers. g=pbias (shared with M3). Shields M2 drain: Vds2 = Vgs1, keeping M2 in saturation and giving high Rout.

connections: M1.d = M1.g = M2.g = M3.s  -> net n1 (bottom diode/bias net)
M3.d = M3.g = M4.g         -> net pbias (cascode gate bias, diode-generated)
M1.s = M2.s = M1.b = M2.b = M3.b = M4.b -> net VSS (common source & bulk)
M3.d = iref (input current port, top of input branch)
M4.d = iout (output current port, top of output branch)
M2.d = M4.s -> net n2 (output branch mid-net, cascode-shielded)

layout_hints.placement: M1 and M3 stacked vertically on the left (input branch); M2 and M4 stacked vertically on the right (output branch). Use interdigitized unit-cell pairs per branch: ref branch = 1 unit cell pair (M1,M3), out branch = 4 unit cell pairs (M2,M4) - the textbook unit-cell method for an exact 1:4 ratio.
layout_hints.routing: Shared gate nodes n1 (M1.g=M2.g) and pbias (M3.g=M4.g) routed horizontally across the gap between branches with straight_route. Source strap VSS on met2. Intra-branch stack routes (M1.d-M3.s = n1; M2.d-M4.s = n2) as nested c_routes on the inner edge. Diode shorts (M1.g-M1.d, M3.g-M3.d) on the free outer edge of the reference branch.
layout_hints.matching: M1/M2 and M3/M4 are matching-critical. Identical unit cell (W=5u, L=1u, 1 finger); output branch has 4x the unit cells. Add edge dummies on the outer edges only (keep gap edge dummy-free for clean cross-gap routing).
layout_hints.finishing: 1) Place bare devices (with_tie=False, with_substrate_tap=False, with_dummy=False) -> 2) Route all nets -> 3) LVS clean -> 4) Add single tapring substrate tie centered on content bbox + edge dummies routed to ring.
layout_hints.ports_labels: Expose ports IREF (M3 drain top), IOUT (M4 drain top), VSS (source strap), and bulk label B (tapring). Place text labels on met2 at each port center for LVS net matching.
